data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 晚宴酒廊的耳畔低语
data.description: 国宾馆奢华套房长椅上，身穿祖母绿抹胸大礼服的王女侧坐在你身旁。她纤细如玉的脚尖轻蹭你的裤腿，凑近耳边用温热的气音述说让整个大陆震颤的双人蜜月计划。
data.action: seated close on velvet sofa, whispering secrets in partner ear with playful smirk, tiara glistening
data.lighting: crystal chandelier warm bokeh with midnight city lights outside
data.mood: intimate political romance, playful conspiracy, irresistible high-society charm
data.promptProse: Whispering cheekily in partner ear on a velvet sofa in an emerald gown, La Folia smiles with brilliant emerald eyes under crystal chandeliers.
